quest.title: Hidden Treasure of Qingce
quest.description: It seems Mt. Qingce is hiding some secrets...

dialogues.speaker: Incomplete Writing
dialogues.text: "With the evil serpent gone from Qingce, the magic formula that subdued it was no longer in effect. ..."

dialogues.speaker: Incomplete Writing
dialogues.text: "...But the serpent did not perish, and its foul blood congealed within the earth and formed stone, poisoning the world..."

dialogues.speaker: Incomplete Writing
dialogues.text: "...Thus three statues were used to subdue it..."

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: ...Just three lines and Paimon's head is hurting. Why are all Liyue's stories written like this?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: But anyway, that bit that goes <color=#00E1FFFF>"foul blood something something formed stone"</color>... does that mean there's <color=#00E1FFFF>strange stone</color> around here?

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Let's take a look around at the <color=#00E1FFFF>stones</color> around here and see if we can find some leads.
